title: postapiauthregistercreatesnewuser
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/register with valid admin authentication and unique user details successfully creates a new user and returns a 201 status.

title: get_api_posts_returns_list
description: Verify that GET /api/posts returns HTTP 200 and a JSON array (public endpoint, no auth required).

title: crud_api_posts_admin
description: Verify that an authenticated admin can create, update, and delete a blog post via POST/PUT/DELETE /api/posts.

title: crud_api_professionals
description: Verify GET /api/professionals is public, and admin can create, update, and delete professionals via CRUD endpoints.

title: api_leads_flow
description: Verify public lead creation (POST /api/leads), admin listing (GET /api/leads), and status update (PUT /api/leads/:id/status).

title: dashboard_settings_track
description: Verify GET /api/dashboard returns stats, POST/GET /api/settings saves and retrieves webhook URL, and POST /api/track records a visit.

title: user_management_crud
description: Verify admin can create, list, update, approve, reject, and delete users via user management endpoints.

title: security_unauthorized_access
description: Verify that all protected routes return 401/403 without a valid token, and login rejects wrong credentials.
